title: calamintha intermedia
intro: Calamintha intermedia, commonly known as Lesser Calamint, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Lesser Calamint include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and relieve symptoms of anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Calamintha intermedia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as camphor and borneol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
